subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should this stack ship an internal path that can promote lineage accounting to authoritative totals despite the remaining day-level residuals, or remain shadow-only until parity and runtime evidence improve?
rationale: The code can enforce a promotion capability, but tests cannot decide whether the remaining user-visible accounting variance and runtime cost are acceptable product behavior.

options.title: Keep shadow-only initially
options.body: Land only non-authoritative lineage accounting and diagnostics until broader exact-head replay and runtime evidence supports promotion.

options.title: Accept gated authority
options.body: Retain the promotion authorization path and explicitly accept the measured residuals, performance envelope, and rollback contract.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Defer the rearchitecture and continue narrower legacy-scanner fixes if its complexity or operational cost is not justified.

recommendation.title: Keep shadow-only initially
recommendation.body: Land only non-authoritative lineage accounting and diagnostics until broader exact-head replay and runtime evidence supports promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available owner for the product-level choice governing user-visible accounting authority and stack landing.
